items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Then John Tran/tella, who was at that time the President of Local 47, he asked me first

ctx.x: Well, Harvey Brooks was a dear friend. He was a wonderful man, a wonderful friend and a very talented man with many, many wonderful tunes to his credit. He was a great ASCAP man, also. He was one of the guys who encouraged me to get into ASCAP, you know. In fact my publisher was the first one to encourage me, but Harvey was really the guy who explained what ASCAP meant, you know, and the benefits of

belonging to ASCAP, you know. So he was just wonderful, and when he passed, that's how I inherited the trial board seat, you know. They asked me -- Marl Young, who is our secretary, the first black secretary that Local 47 has had, he asked me chi if I would serve. Then John Tran/tella, who was at that time the President of Local 47, he asked me first, and then Marle -- I said, "Well, I'll have to let you know." It was just -- it hit me just like something out of the blue, you know. I had never dreamed of nothing…
I remember when that was going on.
